TML.title: TaleSpire Mini Links
TML.noToken: Select a Foundry scene token first.
TML.activeGMOnly: Only the designated active GM can edit links.
TML.recoverPrompt: Token flags can be edited by token owners. Verify and authorize these associations before recovery.
TML.replacePrompt: These associations will be replaced. No creatures or documents will be deleted.
TML.mirrorWarning: Link registry saved, but token flag synchronization failed. The registry remains authoritative.
TML.otherCampaign: This mini belongs to another TaleSpire campaign.
TML.selectionUnsupported: The public TaleSpire API does not support selecting or focusing this mini from Foundry.
TML.enabledHint: Show the mini linking panel. Does not affect the separate dice bridge.
TML.debugHint: Show versions, capabilities and diagnostic errors.
TML.autoTargetHint: Selecting a linked TaleSpire mini that is not yours makes it your target in Foundry, exactly like VN Enhanced's Select as target: the player picks who to hit and attacks. Several selected minis = several targets. Your own mini is never targeted, and clearing the TaleSpire selection keeps your targets. For the GM, 'own' means tokens no player owns (NPCs), so selecting a PC targets it. Works for tokens on the Foundry scene you are viewing.
TML.autoSelectHint: Selecting your own TaleSpire mini controls its token in the current Foundry scene (the attacker). With auto targeting off, it controls any linked mini you are allowed to control.
TML.autoFocusHint: Center the Foundry canvas when automatic selection succeeds.
TML.permission: You do not have permission to access this token.
TML.gmOnly: Only a GM can change links.
TML.changed: Selection or association changed. Refresh and retry.
TML.noCanvas: Foundry canvas or token is unavailable.
TML.otherScene: The linked token is in another scene.
TML.unavailable: Mini bridge unavailable. Enable debug for details.
TML.encDeletePrompt: Delete the encounter {name}? Its minis stay linked, with no encounter.
TML.encAssignHint: Adds the linked minis selected in TaleSpire to this encounter. Minis in another encounter move here.
TML.encReplacePrompt: A combat is running on this scene. End it and start {name}?
TML.encStarted: {name}: combat started with {npcs} NPCs and {pcs} PCs.
TML.encElsewhere: {n} minis of {name} are on another scene and were left out.
TML.encEmpty: This encounter has no minis. Select them in TaleSpire and press Add selection.
TML.encounterName: Enter a name for the encounter.
TML.encounterExists: An encounter with that name already exists.
TML.encounterEmpty: This encounter has no linked minis on the scene you are viewing.
TML.encNoSelection: Select minis in TaleSpire that are already linked.
TML.copied: Copied: {name}. Paste it as the mini's name in TaleSpire.
